fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) has experienced 3 declines of 40% or more during 7 market shocks since listing in December 2018, and currently is down 36.8% from September high.
fields.summary_ko.1: Company achieved 12-month revenue of $15.1 billion with +49.0% year-over-year growth, and operating margin expanded from 7.1% to 9.6%, but faces DRAM and NAND component shortages.
